newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-BLACKBURN POISED TO BUY DANISH STRIKER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BLACKBURN POISED TO BUY DANISH STRIKER.

text.p: Danish striker Per Pedersen is negotiating with English premier League club Blackburn Rovers and a transfer could be signed within the next few days, an official at Odense football club told Reuters on Wednesday.
"I do not know where Pedersen actually is but I can tell you he is in negotiations with Blackburn," the official said.
According to Danish media reports, the 28-year-old striker, is in Blackburn and a 25 million crown (2.5 million pounds) transfer could be completed in time for Rovers' trip to Liverpool on Saturday.
Pedersen recently scored four times for Denmark in a friendly against the United States in San Francisco and was top scorer for his club last season.
